title: DPO loss and implicit rewards
summary: The direct preference optimization loss, its implicit rewards and its gradient, from policy and reference log probabilities.

paper.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model

mutants.beta_twice: Multiplies the margin by beta a second time, so the loss uses beta squared.
mutants.eps_log: Computes the loss as minus log of sigmoid plus 1e-8, so very large margins give wrong losses.
mutants.grad_wrong_sigmoid: Weights the gradient by sigmoid of the margin, not sigmoid of minus the margin.
mutants.in_place_ratio: Subtracts the reference log probabilities in place, so the caller's policy array changes.
mutants.sum_not_mean: Sums the pair losses and gradients and does not divide by N.
mutants.swapped_ratio: Computes the reward as the reference log probability minus the policy log probability.
